title: Credential lifecycle intelligence: orphan key detection, soft-deprecation, and per-scope naming norms
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: We have numerous long-lived service keys and user tokens across hosted and dedicated environments. Current dashboards surface active keys but lack signals for abandoned/orphaned credentials, and our naming conventions are inconsistent which makes automated scoping and rotation risky. Goal: Build a lightweight credential lifecycle intelligence system that (1) surfaces orphaned/unused keys, (2) introduces a soft-deprecation flow with automated owner notifications and staged enforcement, and (3) codifies per-scope naming norms to improve auditability and safe automation. This ticket implements the backend analysis and alerting pipeline plus the admin console annotations needed for operator workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Orphan detection: system flags keys with no activity for N days and marks confidence score; >90% precision in manual sampling
Soft-deprecation flow: flagged key triggers email and console notification to owner; owner can request 30d extension or schedule rotation
Staged enforcement: policy engine can auto-disable keys after grace period with audit trail and rollback flow
Naming norms: console exposes recommended name format for per-scope keys and rejects names that break critical parsers
Audit logs: every state transition (flagging, notification, owner response, disable) is appended to audit log with actor, timestamp, and rationale
Backwards compatibility: no existing key is revoked without explicit enforcement policy and recorded approval
technical_notes: Data sources: token usage events (ingested from runtime telemetry), API gateway logs, console actions table, and existing credential metadata store
Orphan detection heuristic: inactivity window + last-successful-use + token type weight + scope-importance multiplier => confidence score
Privacy: heuristics operate on usage metadata; do not sample request payloads or customer data
Rollout approach: start with internal org and opt-in beta customers, then wider opt-out before enforcement
Scaling: compute detection in daily batch with incremental windowing; aim for <2h processing for active customers dataset
Audit schema: flat events with fields: token_id, previous_state, new_state, actor_id, reason, confidence_score, timestamp (console will surface these)
Edge cases: shared service accounts (multiple owners) should be marked manual-review; cross-region tokens require region-aware policy
implementation_plan: 1) Prototype orphan scoring job in data warehouse (SQL + Python) and validate against sample of 2000 tokens
2) Implement persistence for token lifecycle state in credential metadata store with new 'lifecycle_state' enum
3) Add notification hooks: email template + console banner + in-product inbox message
4) Build console UI: token detail panel shows lifecycle state, confidence score, owner actions (extend/rotate/request-help)
5) Policy engine integration: soft-deprecation policies stored in config service and enforced by admin API
6) Audit log plumbing: write state transitions to audit topic and wire to existing audit UI
7) Beta rollout to internal org, collect feedback, tune thresholds, then release to customers behind feature flag
updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting — aligned on goals with Security PM and Product. Decided N=90 days default inactivity window; thresholds are configurable per org.
2025-02-18: Prototype scoring run completed on production-sampled dataset (5% sample). Initial precision 88% — will iterate heuristics to reach >90%.
2025-02-24: Design sync — console banner and owner inbox patterns approved by Design (see link). Added 'request-help' flow requirement for cross-team keys.

2025-03-05: Blocker discovered: service accounts without owner metadata cause noisy flags. Short-term mitigation: treat ownerless tokens as manual-review and surface to SRE on daily digest. Planning ticket to require owner metadata on creation (separate follow-up).
